## Content Delivery Networks & external resources
This website includes resources from Content Delivery Network services such as JsDelivr, Cloudflare and other remote sources.
These third parties recieve your IP address whenever resources are accessed.

## Cookie banner
This website uses a cookie banner to present you with privacy-related preferences. You can re-open these preferences via “Cookies/analytics preferences” at the bottom of each page on the website.

Regardless of your chosen preferences, “essential” cookies are used to store those preferences.

## Analytics
Right now, this website doesn't use website analytics.

## Changes to this privacy policy
This privacy policy and details about website features described are subject to change. You can find a history of changes on GitHub.
